title: Pure Of the Swamp
summary: The 'Of the Swamp' series unites the watery shapeshifters of the swamp—King of the Swamp, Beastking of the Swamps, Mudragon of the Swamp, Swamp Mirrorer, and Swamp Battleguard! Discard King of the Swamp to search Polymerization, or activate Continuous Trap Monsters Swamp Mirrorer and Quantum Cat (declaring any Type and Attribute you need!) so that any 2 monsters on your field share the exact same Attribute but different Types—letting you fuse them (or your opponent's monsters via Super Polymerization!) into Mudragon of the Swamp and Garura, Wings of Resonant Life while King of the Swamp substitutes for any named Fusion boss!

allow.Keeper of Dragon Magic: Searches Polymerization or Super Polymerization on Normal/Special Summon and revives King of the Swamp or Beastking of the Swamps from your GY.
allow.Polymerization: Searched by King of the Swamp and Keeper of Dragon Magic to fuse your Swamp shapeshifters into Mudragon of the Swamp, Millennium-Eyes Restrict, or Magnum the Reliever.
allow.Super Polymerization: Fuses an opponent's monster with your Type/Attribute-declared Swamp Mirrorer into Mudragon of the Swamp or Garura, Wings of Resonant Life.
allow.Instant Fusion: Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Mudragon of the Swamp or Millennium-Eyes Restrict directly from your Extra Deck.
allow.Fusion Recycling Plant: Field Spell that searches Polymerization and recovers King of the Swamp or Beastking of the Swamps from your GY during every End Phase.
allow.Garura, Wings of Resonant Life: Level 6 Fusion (2 monsters with the same Type and Attribute) summoned via Super Polymerization using a Type/Attribute-declared Swamp Mirrorer / Quantum Cat; draws 1 card when sent to the GY.
allow.Millennium-Eyes Restrict: Level 1 Fusion ('Relinquished' + 1 Effect Monster) summoned using King of the Swamp or Beastking of the Swamps (substituting for Relinquished) + any Effect Monster.
allow.Magnum the Reliever: Level 8 Fusion (1 monster Summoned from the Extra Deck + 1 monster in hand) that recycles Polymerization to draw 1 card and pops cards as a Quick Effect.
allow.Number 101: Silent Honor ARK: Rank 4 WATER Aqua Xyz (2 Level 4 WATER monsters: Beastking of the Swamps or WATER-declared Swamp Mirrorer / Quantum Cat) that detaches 2 materials to absorb an opponent's Special Summoned monster as material!
allow.Predaplant Dragostapelia: Level 8 Fusion (1 Fusion Monster + 1 DARK monster) that places Predator Counters on opposing monsters to negate their activated effects as a Quick Effect!
allow.Starving Venom Fusion Dragon: Level 8 DARK Dragon Fusion (2 DARK monsters on the field except Tokens) that gains ATK and copies an opponent's activated effects.
allow.Tearlaments Rulkallos: Level 8 Aqua Fusion boss providing Special Summon negation and self-revival.

main: King of the Swamp
Core Level 3 WATER Aqua: substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material on a Fusion Monster, OR discards itself from your hand to add 1 'Polymerization' from your Deck to your hand.
Beastking of the Swamps

Core Level 4 WATER Aqua: substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material on a Fusion Monster, and pairs with Level 4 Mudragon of the Swamp or Swamp Mirrorer to Xyz Summon Rank 4 Number 101: Silent Honor ARK!
Swamp Battleguard
Classic EARTH Warrior 'of the Swamp' monster that serves as a different-Type fusion body alongside your WATER/EARTH shapeshifters.
Keeper of Dragon Magic
Discards 1 card on Normal or Special Summon to search Polymerization or Super Polymerization, and revives a Fusion Material from your GY.
Polymerization
Fuses King of the Swamp or Beastking of the Swamps with any Effect Monster into Millennium-Eyes Restrict, Mudragon of the Swamp, or Magnum the Reliever.
Super Polymerization

Fuses 2 monsters on either field into Mudragon of the Swamp (same Attribute, different Types) or Garura, Wings of Resonant Life (same Type and Attribute)—effortlessly enabled by Swamp Mirrorer and Quantum Cat!
Instant Fusion
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Level 4 WATER Mudragon of the Swamp directly from your Extra Deck.
Fusion Recycling Plant
Searches Polymerization by discarding a card and recovers King of the Swamp from your GY during the End Phase.
Swamp Mirrorer

Signature Continuous Trap Monster: declares 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute to Special Summon itself as a Level 4 Normal Monster (1800 ATK / 100 DEF) with that exact Type and Attribute—custom-tailoring the exact Type/Attribute needed for Mudragon of the Swamp or Garura!
Quantum Cat
Companion Swamp Continuous Trap Monster: declares 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute to Special Summon itself as a Level 4 Normal Monster (0 ATK / 2200 DEF) with that exact Type and Attribute!
extra: Signature Level 4 WATER Wyrm Fusion boss (2 monsters with the same Attribute but different Types): your opponent cannot target this card, or any monsters on the field with the same Attribute, with card effects; Quick Effect to change its Attribute to any Attribute!

Level 6 Fusion (2 monsters with the same Type and Attribute): summoned via Super Polymerization or Polymerization using a Type/Attribute-declared Swamp Mirrorer / Quantum Cat; draws 1 card when sent to the GY.
Summoned using King of the Swamp or Beastking of the Swamps (substituting for Relinquished) + 1 Effect Monster to absorb and negate opposing monsters.
Summoned using Mudragon of the Swamp + 1 monster in hand; recycles Polymerization to draw 1 card and pops cards as a Quick Effect.
Rank 4 WATER Aqua Xyz (2 Level 4 WATER monsters) that detaches 2 materials to absorb an opponent's Special Summoned monster as material and protects itself from destruction!
Level 8 Fusion (1 Fusion Monster + 1 DARK monster) that places Predator Counters on opposing monsters to negate their activated effects as a Quick Effect!
Level 8 DARK Dragon Fusion summoned via Super Polymerization using any 2 DARK monsters on the field.
Level 8 Fusion: protects Aqua monsters from battle; Quick Effect negates an effect that Special Summons; revives if sent to GY.
